# Invented cards

Every card in these files is made up. None is a real Magic: The Gathering card, and
none was copied from Scryfall. They are written in the shape of Scryfall's entries so the
tests can cover each awkward case with no card file downloaded and no card text copied.

The same goes for the rulings and the tags beside them: `rulings.jsonl`,
`oracle_tags.jsonl` and `art_tags.jsonl` hold invented rulings and invented community
labels on the invented cards and their invented pictures. No real ruling text is here.
